apk.notes: Settings → Delete My Account. A shop's only owner can save a copy of its inventory and transactions first (install this version of the app for that).

web.notes: Privacy Policy link under the sign-in box and in Settings.

desktop.notes: Report a Problem: tell us when something isn't working. On the computer it's the button at the top right; on the phone it's at the top of Settings. If something goes wrong unexpectedly, a red bar offers Report This.
